knowledge.title: The property cross-reference keys on SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID
knowledge.content: Join PROPERTY_CORE.SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID to PROPERTY_CROSS_REFERENCE.SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID (not SOURCE_UNIQUE_ID), together with UPPER(REF_GDP_SOURCE_SYSTEM.GDP_SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME) = UPPER(SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME).

knowledge.title: Resolve properties through the full cross-reference, never the delta
knowledge.content: Use PROPERTY_MDM.PROPERTY_CROSS_REFERENCE for resolution. STAGE.PROPERTY_CROSS_REFERENCE_ENTITY_ID holds only the properties changed in the current run; FACT_LEASE and FACT_SALE resolve through it today and lose DIM_PROPERTY_SKEY for unchanged properties.

knowledge.title: Property cross-reference deletes are MDM_DELETE_DATE
knowledge.content: A deleted property cross-reference row has MDM_DELETE_DATE set (company uses MDM_DELETED_DATE) or MDM_STATUS 'INACTIVE'. Filter GDP_IS_ACTIVE and MDM_DELETE_DATE IS NULL, and keep the latest row per SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID and SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME by MDM_POST_MDM_LUD then MDM_UPDATED_TS.

knowledge.title: Many source properties master to one Lightbox building
knowledge.content: Lightbox is the property spine (about one cross-reference row per building); EDP, MTA and DIQ records merge onto Lightbox buildings, so many source records share one CBRE_ENTERPRISE_PROPERTY_ID (EDP: 3.1M active rows to 880K ids). Aggregate facts at the mastered id, not the source record, when the business asks per property.

knowledge.title: VW_PROPERTY_CROSS_REFERENCE maps source records to gold skeys
knowledge.content: For read-only analysis, GOLD_PROPERTY_DB.PROPERTY.VW_PROPERTY_CROSS_REFERENCE gives SOURCE_SYSTEM_NAME, SOURCE_SYSTEM_ID, CBRE_ENTERPRISE_PROPERTY_ID and DIM_PROPERTY_SKEY; check its active semantics before relying on it in models.

knowledge.title: Why a pre-MDM property has no cross-reference
knowledge.content: PROPERTY_MDM.PRE_MDM_UPDATED_RECORDS records each pre-MDM property's DQ_STATUS and POST_MDM_STATUS; use it to explain a missing cross-reference (filtered by DQ, or not processed yet) instead of guessing.

knowledge.title: -1 means unresolved, at two different layers
knowledge.content: A silver PROPERTY_CORE_SKEY of -1 means no pre-MDM match; a gold DIM_PROPERTY_SKEY of -1 means no MDM or dimension match. Diagnose layer by layer.

knowledge.title: MDM tables are versioned
knowledge.content: Deduplicate MDM tables to the latest version with ORDER BY MDM_POST_MDM_LUD DESC NULLS LAST, MDM_UPDATED_TS DESC NULLS LAST.
